entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: Spirit-like species trapped in the Shadows of Rath, who originally lived on Dominaria; mostly white-aligned.

entities.name: Shadows of Rath
entities.description: Extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria where the Soltari are trapped.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane surrounded by a maelstrom of energy.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: Race at war with the Soltari who lost their sanity in the Shadows.

entities.name: Thalakos
entities.description: Neutral race caught in the Soltari-Dauthi conflict who lost their sanity.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship whose planeshifting engine was damaged in battle with the Predator.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Ship that battled and pursued the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Wizard adept who volunteered to keep the Erratic Portal open.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: Soltari Emissary who offered to aid Ertai's rituals in exchange for use of the portal.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker in league with Lyna who waited on the other side of the portal.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Owner of the flagship crippled when Urza slammed the portal shut.

events.summary: The Soltari, at war with the Dauthi, are trapped with the Thalakos in the Shadows between Rath and Dominaria.
events.quote: All three races were trapped in the maelstrom of energy that surrounded Rath

events.summary: Ertai agrees to open the portal with Lyna's help and is left behind as the Weatherlight flees.
events.quote: Ertai agreed, and they successfully opened the portal

events.summary: Urza, in league with Lyna, slams the portal shut and cripples Volrath's flagship.
events.quote: Urza slammed the portal shut, crippling Volrath 's flagship in the process

relations.quote: the Soltari were at war with the Dauthi
contacted by the Soltari Emissary Lyna
